entries.title: Isaiah 17:1
segments: ¶The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from [being] a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:2
segments: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks; and they shall lie down and there shall be none to make them afraid.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:3
segments: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith Jehovah of hosts.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:4
segments: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall become lean.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:5
segments: And it shall be as when the reaper gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; yea, it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:6
segments: ¶And a gleaning shall be left in it, as at the shaking of an olive-tree: two, three berries above, in the tree-top; four, five in its fruitful boughs, saith Jehovah, the God of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:7
segments: In that day shall man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have regard to the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:8
segments: And he will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, nor have regard to what his fingers have made, neither the Asherahs nor the sun-images.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:9
segments: ¶In that day shall his strong cities be as the forsaken tract in the woodland, and the mountain-top which they forsook before the children of Israel; and there shall be desolation.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:10
segments: For thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength; therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plantations, and shalt set them with foreign slips:

entries.title: Isaiah 17:11
segments: in the day of thy planting wilt thou make [them] to grow, and on the morrow wilt thou make thy seed to flourish; [but] the harvest will flee in the day of taking possession, and the sorrow will be incurable.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:12
segments: ¶Ha! a tumult of many peoples! they make a noise as the noise of the seas; --and the rushing of nations! they rush as the rushing of mighty waters.

entries.title: Isaiah 17:13
segments: The nations rush as the rushing of many waters; but he will rebuke them, and they shall flee far away, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a whirling [of dust] before the whirlwind:

entries.title: Isaiah 17:14
segments: behold, at eventide, trouble; before the morning they are not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
